title: Protocol to isolate cells in four stages of S phase for high-resolution replication-timing sequencing
protocol: Seed 2 × 10^6 RPE cells in four 15 cm² plates for 48 hours.
Label the cells with 100 μM BrdU for 2 hours at 37°C.
Rinse the cells with 1× PBS and add 2.5 mL of trypsin per 15 cm² plate.
Wash the cells with 1× PBS containing 1% FBS.
Centrifuge the cells for 2 minutes at 100 g.
Resuspend the cells in ice cold 2.5 mL 1× PBS with 1% FBS.
Add 7.5 mL EtOH slowly and dropwise while vortexing.
Centrifuge the cells for 5 minutes at 100 g at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 3 mL 1× PBS with 1% FBS.
Add 1/100 Propidium Iodide and RNAse A to a concentration of 250 μg/mL.
Incubate for 1 hour at 18°C–25°C in the dark.
Keep the cells on ice until sorting.
Sort the cells with a BD FACS Fusion Tex Red A laser.
Place P5 (G1) and P6 (G2) gates first, then divide remaining four phases across S phase equally.
Collect P1 (S1) to P4 (S4) in 500 μL of PBS, aiming for at least 250,000 cells per fraction.
Add SDS to 0.8% and proteinase K to 20 μg/mL to each fraction.
Incubate the mixture 2 hours at 55°C.
Add one volume of phenol-chloroform to each fraction.
Vortex the mixture thoroughly.
Centrifuge the mixture for 1 minute at maximum speed.
Collect as much upper phase as possible and transfer into 15 mL conical tubes.
Add 1/9 volume of 3 M sodium acetate pH 5.2 to the sample.
Add 2.5 volumes of ice cold 100% EtOH and 1 μL (20 μg) of glycogen to the sample.
Vortex the mixture thoroughly.
Incubate at -80°C for 12-20 hours.
Transfer 2 mL of each sample to 2 mL low-bind DNA tubes.
Centrifuge at maximum speed at 4°C for 17 minutes.
Remove supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Repeat step until all material is precipitated in the same tube.
Wash pellet with 500 μL of 70% EtOH.
Centrifuge at maximum speed at 4°C for 2 minutes.
Remove the supernatant and air dry the pellet.
Resuspend DNA in 100 μL of 10 mM Tris pH 8.
Sonicate DNA at amplitude 70% for a total time on of 12 min (ON:OFF ratio 20s:40s).
Evaluate size of DNA using TapeStation D1000 or Bioanalyzer.
Heat denature the DNA for 2 minutes at 95°C.
Move immediately on ice and spin down the contents when cold.
Take 75 μL of DNA, add 45 μL of 10× IP buffer (10× PBS, 0.5% Triton-X100) and 330 μL of RNAse free H2O.
Wash 50 μL of Protein G magnetic beads with 1× IP buffer and resuspend in 1× IP buffer.
Add 50 μL of washed beads and 2 μL of anti-BrdU antibody to the DNA prepared in step 23.
Incubate for 2.5 hours under rotation at 18°C–25°C in the dark.
Place the tubes on a magnetic rack and remove the supernatant.
Wash the beads with 1 mL 1× IP buffer, vortex thoroughly, place the tubes on the magnetic stand and remove the supernatant.
Repeat washing with 1 mL 1× IP buffer for 4 more washes.
Reconstitute beads in 200 μL of 1× IP buffer containing 250 μg/mL proteinase K.
Incubate the mixture for 2 hours at 55°C in the dark.
Transfer eluates from the beads and add 200 μL phenol/chloroform to each sample.
Vortex the samples thoroughly, then centrifuge for 1 minute at maximum speed.
Collect the upper phase carefully without transferring the interface.
Add 1/9 volume of 3 M sodium acetate pH 5.2 to the collected upper phase.
Add 2.5 volumes of ice cold 100% EtOH and 1 μL of glycogen to each sample.
Vortex the samples again, then incubate overnight at -80°C.
Centrifuge the samples for 17 minutes at maximum speed at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant from each sample without disturbing the pellet.
Wash the pellet with 500 μL of 70% EtOH.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at maximum speed at 4°C, then remove the supernatant.
Air dry the pellet thoroughly.
Resuspend the DNA in 75 μL of 10 mM Tris pH 8.
Set up 10 μL qPCR reactions using 0.5 μL of IP and 1% input (0.75 μL denatured DNA diluted to 75 μL).
Use actin and satellite 2 primers for the qPCR reaction.
Troubleshoot according to guidelines if necessary.
Start with 15 μL of immunoprecipitated DNA for library preparation.
Denature the DNA according to the protocol.
Add adaptase as per the protocol instructions.
Extend the DNA using the provided guidelines.
Clean up the DNA following the protocol for less than 10 ng gDNA.
Perform ligation according to the specified protocol.
Clean up the ligated DNA following the gDNA cleanup instructions.
Conduct indexing PCR with 7 cycles, adjusting cycle numbers if needed based on initial DNA quantity.
Clean up after indexing PCR as per the gDNA cleanup procedure.
Validate the libraries using a TapeStation or a Bioanalyzer.
Proceed to sequencing.
